name: identity-login-plane
description: TEMPORARY smoke artifact (openspec add-multi-user-identity-plane D19/D20): an INDEPENDENT-FRONTEND login provider. Serves its own sign-in/out pages AND its own frontend (`/identity-login/app`) over the dashboard's Fastify instance, routes the browser to a real Keycloak, does the OIDC exchange server-side, and hands the bearer to the PLUGIN page's own memory (plugin-owned fragment, stripped immediately — never the dashboard root). Drop into <state-dir>/plugins/ to be discovered.
